text:
maria: Hi team — accepted the org invite this morning but hitting permissions when trying to push. GitHub shows I'm a Member, but pushing gives: "remote: error: insufficient permission: protected branch". Who should I ask to fix my team mapping or role?

devon: Welcome! Often that happens if SSO mapping or team auto-assign didn't run. Did you accept SSO via Okta and use your work email for the invite?

maria: Yep accepted SSO and used maria@redwood.ai. I uploaded my SSH key too. Repo is redwood/frontend-app and branch is feature/e2e-fix. Trying to push to trigger CI.

kira: pinging @scott-platform for team sync help. Also check if the branch is protected with a push restriction to a specific team.

onboard-bot: Onboarding status: maria — SSO accepted, SSH key uploaded. Platform team alerted for team-sync.

scott: Looking. Your account was created via an alternate alias (maria.j) so the auto team assignment skipped you. I can run the sync or add you to frontend-devs with write access. Which do you need?

maria: Need write now to push a quick fix, PR will handle the rest.

scott: Done: gave temporary write to redwood/frontend-app and re-ran the team auto-sync against both aliases. Also relaxed the branch protection rule for your push-to-branch so you can force through the CI trigger. Try this sequence:
```bash
git checkout -b feature/e2e-fix
# make the change
git add .
git commit -m "fix(e2e): flaky hook"
git push origin feature/e2e-fix
```

devon: If you want to verify your team membership from CLI after auth, you can run:
```bash
gh api /user/teams --jq '.[] .name'
```
or view Organization -> Teams on your GitHub profile.

kira: We should add a note in /docs/onboarding/github-permissions about alias invites and branch-protection edge cases. Filing follow-up ticket.

maria: Push succeeded, PR created, CI started. Thanks :tada:

scott: I'll add a short postmortem to ticket INF-2345 to make the auto-assign tolerant of alias variants and to avoid temporary branch-protection relaxations in future. Leaving this thread.

maria: Confirmed everything works, closing.
